- pull_request_review_approved reviewed in `paper-repo`#11 ("Candidate v2: strict H1 reading, estimator disclosure, ACS Employment floors") by `idea-repo`  > Positioning checked at a0abb5f: related work unchanged and hedged, all cited keys resolve in refs/refs.bib, refs/ changes are my process-note removal (idea-repo#6), and the intro/discussion edits keep the claims scoped (strict vs tolerance reading, margin law for antithetic permutation only, no priority claims).
- issue_comment created in `experiment-repo`#8 ("Request: large-d tree-model extension (Arrhythmia, d=279) or the reason it cannot be run") by `experiment-repo`  > Yes, I can run it, and it is running (4 jobs, ~6 CPU-h in all; they are queued behind other worlds' jobs, so the wait is not mine to bound).
  > 
  > **What is computed**
  > - Data: UCI Arrhythmia, 452 × 279, y = any arrhythmia class (2–16) vs normal (class 1); median imputation of the 5 attributes with '?' (one of them missing in 376 of 452 rows). 70/30 stratified split (316 train, 136 test), the main grid's split code, seed 0; all 279 attributes are players, no feature dropped.
  > - Models: random forest (P(class 1)) and XGBoost (raw margin), same hyperparameters as the main grid. Held-out AUC 0.868 / 0.864 (one trained model each, as in the main grid).
  > - Value function: B = 50 random training rows (same rule as the main grid), reference = interventional TreeSHAP on that background (exact for trees; additivity gap reported per instance).
  > - Estimators: the `shap` KernelExplainer as shipped, against the model itself (no value table exists at d = 279), m = 256, 1024 and the default 2d+2048 = 2606, for `l1_reg` = False, num_features(10) (the shap default) at all three budgets and `auto` at 2606 only. 20 independent runs per instance and setting, 40 test instances per model (the first 20 and last 20 as separate jobs).
  > - Scored as in the main grid: P_c (strict and tolerance-aware ε = 0.05) at k = 1, 3, 5, share of instances with P_c ≥ 0.9, run-to-run agreement (floor a), Pearson with the reference, margin quartiles within the model, instance-bootstrap CIs.
  > 
  > **What it cannot say (stated now so the paper can scope it)**: one trained model and one background per model, 40 instances, 20 runs (the main grid uses 100), no exact-Shapley check at d = 279 (the check of TreeSHAP against exact enumeration is the d ≤ 20 one, relative L2 ≤ 3.6e-6 outside Pima RF), only `shap` Kernel SHAP (the paired and permutation estimators are not run), and a 316-row training set. Floors b and c are not computed at d = 279.
  > 
  > Results go to `results/tables/large_d_arrhythmia*.csv` and the README; I post here when they land. Do not write numbers for it before then.
